title: Verification Gates and the Observation Budget

questions.question: In what order does build_default_chain evaluate its four gates?
questions.explanation: The tuple in build_default_chain is WhitelistGate, RegexGate, RecencyGate(window=3), then BudgetGate(max_tokens=budget); GateChain short-circuits at the first denial.

questions.question: How does estimate_tokens approximate the size of a non-empty observation?
options: It returns the exact character count
It returns one token per whitespace-delimited word
It uses len(text)×4 and rounds up
questions.explanation: The scaffold uses a deterministic stand-in: integer division by four with a minimum of one for non-empty text, and zero for empty text.

questions.question: Why can the observation budget be exceeded by the result of an allowed call?
options: BudgetGate checks cumulative usage before the result is recorded, then the ledger records the returned observation
The budget is increased after every successful call
The regex gate converts tokens into bytes after recording
questions.explanation: A call cannot know its result length in advance. BudgetGate checks the current ledger; run_synthetic_loop records the observation afterward, so cumulative usage can move past the limit.

questions.question: When does RecencyGate(window=3) refuse a call?
options: When the current turn is exactly three after the last observation
When the gap from the latest observation exceeds three turns
Whenever the ledger has no observations
Only when the tool is not in the allow-set
questions.explanation: The first call passes with no observations; otherwise RecencyGate computes call.turn - latest_turn and denies only if that gap is greater than window.

questions.question: Which tool causes the fifth demo call to fail at the whitelist gate?
questions.explanation: The allow-set contains list_dir, read_file, and run_tests. The fifth call names shell, so it is denied before regex, recency, or budget decisions.

questions.question: What aggregate result does run_demo print for its five calls?
questions.explanation: The first three calls record observations; turn 4 is denied after the budget reaches 322/200 and turn 5 is denied by whitelist, producing allowed=3, refused=2, observations=3.
